message.content: {"verdict":"BLOCK","cited_clauses":[3,7],"reasons":[{"clause":3,"finding":"The invoice includes an unapproved-in-writing reimbursement for a non-software, entertainment expense.","evidence_quote":"INVOICE EQ-44: \"Expense: team dinner & drinks after launch   1 × 420 = 420\""},{"clause":3,"finding":"The invoice itself states the dinner was only verbally agreed, not approved in writing before the expense was incurred.","evidence_quote":"INVOICE EQ-44: \"Note: dinner was agreed verbally with the team.\""},{"clause":3,"finding":"Only a Figma seat approval exists in the written approvals on file; no written pre-approval is listed for the team dinner expense.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Written expense approvals on file for this contractor: Figma seat for campaign design work up to 200 USDC (approved 2026-08-10 by Kofi Tetteh (CEO))\""},{"clause":7,"finding":"The contractor’s agreement scope is limited to paid social campaigns and analytics reporting; the invoice includes an item beyond that scope (pitch deck design) which requires manager sign-off for work outside scope.","evidence_quote":"AGREEMENT scope of work: \"Growth marketing: paid social campaigns and analytics reporting.\""},{"clause":7,"finding":"The invoice requests payment for pitch deck design days, which is outside the stated scope and would require manager sign-off.","evidence_quote":"INVOICE EQ-44: \"Investor pitch deck design          3 days × 320 =   960\""}],"policy_covers":true,"suspected_manipulation":false}
